name: Vitreous-Arete
description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed an ancient meteor crater in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on uranium are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
